deploy_image_pins.note: name:tag@digest made `docker manifest inspect` resolve the moved tag; digest-only refs used.

evaluation_rate_limit.cause: M8a made rate_limit.mode default redis; the CLI evaluation (C4) runs the API in process without Redis/key secret, so every seeded login was 503 rate_limit_unavailable. The autouse test fixture replaces the limiter factory, so the suite did not see it.
